strategy_roster.name: Automatic Trendlines
strategy_roster.notes: SMA(100) is a conservative long-only proxy for a pivot-derived 100/15-bar resistance line, with SMA(20) confirming the short trend. Actual pivot queues, connecting lines, and the short-side reversal are unavailable; no stops are documented.

strategy_roster.name: TrainYourself
strategy_roster.notes: The documented 20-candle Donchian channel and breakout execution are retained with the mirrored breakdown as exit. The 50/2-point buffer and activation margin, re-entry arming state, and 100/100-point protection are omitted.

strategy_roster.name: Magna Rapax Copper
strategy_roster.entry_long: macd_signal(close,12,26,9) > 0 and ema(close,2) > ema(close,3) and ema(close,3) > ema(close,5) and ema(close,5) > ema(close,8) and ema(close,8) > ema(close,13) and ema(close,13) > ema(close,21) and ema(close,21) > ema(close,34) and ema(close,34) > ema(close,55) and ema(close,55) > ema(close,89) and ema(close,89) > ema(close,144) and ema(close,144) > ema(close,233) and adx(high,low,close,14) > 25
strategy_roster.exit_long: macd_signal(close,12,26,9) < 0 and ema(close,2) < ema(close,3) and ema(close,3) < ema(close,5) and ema(close,5) < ema(close,8) and ema(close,8) < ema(close,13) and ema(close,13) < ema(close,21) and ema(close,21) < ema(close,34) and ema(close,34) < ema(close,55) and ema(close,55) < ema(close,89) and ema(close,89) < ema(close,144) and ema(close,144) < ema(close,233) and adx(high,low,close,14) > 25
strategy_roster.notes: All eleven documented EMA lengths are retained in strict bullish and bearish stacks with positive/negative MACD signal and ADX(14)>25. MACD and ADX parameters and the threshold are not supplied, so 12/26/9, 14, and 25 are explicit fallbacks.

strategy_roster.name: Multi Currency Template
strategy_roster.notes: EMA(9/21) is an explicit fallback translation of the unspecified EMA crossover. Martingale averaging, pip stop/target, trailing, direction modes, and multiple-currency state are omitted.

strategy_roster.name: Up3x1 Shifted SMA Strategy (MT4 Conversion)
strategy_roster.notes: The documented SMA(24/60/120) triple alignment is retained without a positive shift because shifted values cannot be addressed. The 150/100-point target and stop and trailing/lot controls are not percentage exits.

strategy_roster.name: Big Dog Range Breakout
strategy_roster.notes: A prior 14-bar range approximates the default 14:00-16:00 two-hour box, with ATR(14) below its average proxying the narrow-range filter. Session timing, point distance filters, and consolidation-extreme targets are omitted.

strategy_roster.name: Master MM Droid
strategy_roster.notes: The RSI money-management block is represented by a cross above the fallback lower level 30, exiting on renewed weakness or overbought 70. Other box, weekly-gap, schedule, pyramiding, and point-trailing modules are omitted.

strategy_roster.name: CME Equity Futures Price Limits
strategy_roster.notes: The source only captures and logs CME limit levels, so impossible price guards deliberately prevent fabricated trades. Reference-hour capture, manual override, and percentage-limit logging are outside the trading DSL.

strategy_roster.name: On Tick Market Watch
strategy_roster.notes: This is intentionally a non-trading tick monitor, so impossible guards preserve its lack of orders. Symbol lists, Level1 events, bid/spread logging, and cross-security subscriptions are unavailable.

strategy_roster.name: Get Rich GBP Session Reversal
strategy_roster.notes: The documented 18-bar bearish count is approximated by negative 18-bar return with RSI confirmation for a long reversal. London/New York hours, 100/40/30-point partial exits, and money management are unavailable.
